title: Goals
description: data of: goals.py [FIELD] --json. What each programme and planned target is for and when it has enough: purpose, timing, and minimum, worth-it, desired and stretch levels in the purpose's own measure (docs/observing-plan-spec.md, Phase 2).

enabled.description: Whether [plan] goals is on: captures keep going to their desired accepted frames, or the cap.

programme.description: The programme's file name, or targets/NAME for a planned target; null when nothing names the field.

cap.description: The time a capture may run, as a multiple of its planned minutes.

case.description: A known transient's reference case: 1 a reference from before it, 2 a model of the host, 3 a detection or an upper limit only.

depth.description: G where half of planted stars are found.

quality_max.description: The largest share of the field whose subtraction may be out of line.
